note: LIB-20 to LIB-23: one page of one category of the Campaign Library. It is a request BODY even when there is no search, because search text may never travel in a URL (X-7) and one shape is simpler than two. The Cues category lists cues, not documents, and belongs to the cue family.

valid.name: the first page of NPCs, most recently updated first
a search, by name, qualifier or tag
Documents filtered to one type, continuing from a cursor
the Archived filter, where Delete lives (LIB-18)
a search of only a byte order mark is no search: trimmed away on both sides
NEL is not trimmed on either side, so this search is two characters long

invalid.name: a one-character search
invalid.why: LIB-20: at least two characters, after trimming

invalid.name: a search of 101 characters
invalid.why: a search is at most 100 characters

invalid.name: the Cues category
invalid.why: LIB-5: cues are not documents; their listing is the cue family's

invalid.name: a type filter outside Documents
invalid.why: LIB-22: only Documents holds more than one type

invalid.name: a type that lives in another category
invalid.why: LIB-6: membership is a registry fact; an NPC is never in Documents

invalid.name: a sort that does not exist
invalid.why: LIB-22: recent or name, each with a stable total order

invalid.name: a page of 51
invalid.why: LIB-23: 25 at a time, and never more than 50

invalid.name: no campaign
invalid.why: LIB-25: lists are keyed by campaign

invalid.name: every category at once
invalid.why: LIB-21: a single search across categories is not in v1

invalid.name: full-text search switched on by the client
invalid.why: LIB-21: search matches name, qualifier and tags; a request is strict, so a stray key is a client bug

invalid.name: a lone surrogate in the search
invalid.why: JSON allows the escape; UTF-8 does not. Refused on both sides, so it is a 422 and never a failure to query
